title: Kecksburg craft was bell-shaped
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Kecksburg craft was bell-shaped, about 1965 at Kecksburg, Pennsylvania, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: crash. I will say that the craft at Kexsburg in the movie was incorrectly portrayed as a flying saucer when in reality it was shaped like a bell or acorn.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about the 1965 crash at Kecksburg, a small town in Pennsylvania where something is said to have come down from the sky. He says a movie wrongly showed the object as a flying saucer, when it was really shaped like a bell or an acorn. He brings it up while talking about how films portray real reported cases.
